description: Equivalent mutants excluded from the mutation score. An entry excludes a mutant only when module, line, operator, original and mutant all match exactly; an entry that matches nothing is reported as stale. The harness refuses an entry unless the commit that first holds it was authored by a person, not the agent or any other bot, so each one reaches main through a pull request the owner approves. See docs/reference/mutation-testing.md.

schema.module: string: the module path relative to the repository root, such as automation/supervisor/policy.py
schema.line: integer: the first line of the mutated node
schema.operator: string: one of delete_statement, return_none, loop_control, comparison, boolean_operator, remove_not, boolean_constant, number_increment, number_zero, swap_arguments
schema.original: string: the mutated node's source text before the change, exactly as the report prints it
schema.mutant: string: the same node's text after the change, exactly as the report prints it
schema.reason: string: why the mutant cannot change behaviour
